briefdescription.para: Get handle to requested device node by "only" Node INDEX.

detaileddescription.para:
DeviceIndex
Device Node Index
Pointer to requested XPm_Device, NULL otherwise
Requires ONLY Node Index Caller should be careful while using this function as it skips the checks for validating the class, subclass and type of the device before and after retrieving the node from the database. briefdescription.para: Return the current power state of a device node.

detaileddescription.para:
DeviceId
Node ID of the device to query
DeviceState
Filled with the device node state; set to XPM_DEVSTATE_UNUSED when the device is not found
XST_SUCCESS on success, error code otherwise Return the current power state of a device node.

para.verbatim: Initializes the output to XPM_DEVSTATE_UNUSED, looks up DeviceId in the device database, and replaces the output with the node state when the device exists. Lookup failures are also logged.

parameterdescription.para: Complete device node ID to look up.
Non-NULL output pointer receiving the device state, or XPM_DEVSTATE_UNUSED when the lookup fails.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS when the device is found, or XPM_PM_INVALID_NODE when DeviceId does not identify a registered device.
